title: Le Festival Afro Latino de Meaux 2026
description:
🔷 Meaux Afro-Latino Festival 🔷
🔷 🔷 🔷 🔷 9th Edition 🔷 🔷 🔷 🔷
🚨 SAVE THE DATE: November 6, 7 & 8, 2026 🚨
From Friday, Nov 6, 2026, to Sunday, Nov 8, 2026
Looking to have fun 🎉, learn or hone your Afro-Latin dance skills, and meet new people?
You’ve come to the right place—come let loose! An intimate, festive, and friendly festival.
└ 𝙏𝙞𝙘𝙠𝙚𝙩𝙨 ┐ https://tickets.tickie.io/…/festival-afro-latino-de…
🕗 An incredible lineup, dance workshops 💃🕺🏻, a lecture on the history of Bachata with Roberto Burgos, 3 dance parties, 3 rooms/3 vibes (SBK), and shows.
🍔🍟 Food trucks & caterers on-site for your convenience 🌯🧇 plus exhibitors throughout the weekend.
⭐️ PARTIES | WORKSHOPS | FIESTA | ALEGRIA
✔️ Teachers of quality
✔️ Workshops
✔️Salsa: Son / Timba / Rueda / Rumba / ChaChaCha / Casino / Estillo / Mambo
✔️Bachata: Moderna / Sensual / Dominicana / Fusion / Bachata Zouk
✔️Kizomba: Urban / Traditional / Semba / Ginga / Tarraxa
✔️Dj’s Salsa / Bachata / Kizomba
